title: 150 Meters Away: Museum Archives Become New Story Stops | vitalii.no
description:
Kilometers of road used to pass in total silence, even when real local history sat right next to the track — because the places the app already knew about were sitting 250 to 600 meters off the road, well outside its reach. Genuine archived finds, photographs and museum records, were going completely unused just because nothing nearby was close enough.

A research step now queries DigitaltMuseum — Kulturhistorisk museum's finds, old photographs, DigitaltFortalt stories — for anything with coordinates within 150 meters of the drive track. A hit near a place the app already knows gets appended straight to that place's research file. A hit with nothing nearby creates a brand-new place instead, named after the farm the find is associated with, so it flows into the normal story pipeline exactly like a manually curated stop.

Stretches of road that used to pass in silence now surface real archived finds instead of losing them — all from a 150-meter search radius around the track.
